primary_findings.title: T5 service steam/water toe_factor unit ambiguity — totals may be 1000x wrong
evidence: pcs-backend/app/services/util/utility_energy_summary_service.py:167 — `agg.steam_t_yr * s_toe` multiplies TONNES by toe_factor 0.0760 (per kg in config model docstring; service treats as per-tonne)
primary_findings.process_engineering_correction: Per 工艺工程师正式确认 (2026-10-01): toe_factor 统一 per-tonne. service 数学正确. seed 数值需修正: STEAM 0.0760 → 94.4 (GB/T 50441-2004 旧版 per-kg → 2016 版 per-tonne); WATER 0.0001 → 0.1 (GB/T 50441-2016 附录 A per-kg × 1000 → per-tonne). 不改 service, 改 seed + docstring. golden fixture Case 1 差异 ~24% 远超 2% 验收容差, 需重算.
primary_findings.suggested_fix: (A) 改 ConfigEnergyConversionFactor docstring + seed 数值 (STEAM 94.4 / WATER 0.1 per-tonne); (B) 加 TODO 禁综合能耗报告出厂直到 10-08 工艺室签署; (C) 改 golden fixture 标注 PENDING_SIGN_OFF + 重算 case 1 (蒸汽 1520 → 1888000 kg 标油).

primary_findings.title: T5 summarize_energy_year TOCTOU race — concurrent POSTs return 500
evidence: utility_energy_summary_service.py:245-296 — non-locking SELECT then INSERT-or-UPDATE branch without `for_update()` or transaction wrap
primary_findings.process_engineering_correction: Per 工艺工程师 2026-10-01: 复用 D2 2A 模式 (advisory lock per key) 而非 upsert/catch-retry. 与 sync_from_source 的 advisory_lock.py 实现一致.
